page.notes: Line numbers 5–30 in the margin are printed line-count numerals, not notes. Running head and page number 503 at top. The reading "resposition" in line 21 is not reliable; the printed word is "responsionem" partly obscured by a fold. The text "tibus" at the foot is the catchword. Several small marginal marks (manuscript annotations in the right and left edges of the scan) are handwriting and were omitted.
